verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists clips and playlists of highlights from meetings, so cutting moments from a call is a first-party capability. But the evidence is limited to brief pricing bullets: nothing documents how a clip is created or how it is shared in place of the full recording. Missing for 10: documented clip-creation workflow, explicit sharing of individual clips/soundbites (links, permissions, external viewers), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can cut a soundbite or highlight clip from a call and share that moment instead of the whole recording
